language.title: Use your preferred language
language.body: Use this button to switch between English and Hindi. Page labels and this guide follow your choice; workbook contents stay unchanged.

assignments.title: Choose your template
assignments.body: Check the template name and reporting period. The available buttons show how you can prepare your data.

online.title: Fill the workbook online
online.body: Open the template here and enter your data directly in the workbook.

download.title: Prefer working in Excel?
download.body: Download the template to work on your computer. Keep the template structure, then upload your completed workbook.

upload.title: Upload a completed workbook
upload.body: Choose this option when your completed Excel file is ready to send.

submitted-note.title: Already submitted
submitted-note.body: This template has been submitted. Editing is closed unless SSD returns it for correction; submission is not approval or publication.

logout.title: Finished for now?
logout.body: Use Logout to end access on this tab, especially on a shared computer.

returned.title: Start with the review comments
returned.body: Read what SSD has asked you to correct, update your workbook, and submit it again when ready.

workbook.title: Your workspace
workbook.body: Select a cell to enter or correct data. Use the sheet tabs below to move between worksheets.

file.title: Attach your completed file
file.body: Choose your completed .xlsx workbook. Check its name and size; use Remove to clear it and choose a replacement if needed.

note.title: Add a note
note.body: Use this field to explain changes or give SSD useful context about your submission.

evidence.title: Supporting files
evidence.body: Attach the requested evidence, following the file types and size limits shown. You can remove an attachment before sending.

certification.title: Confirm the declaration
certification.body: Read the declaration carefully. Select it only when it is true and you are ready to confirm your data.

draft.title: Save without submitting
draft.body: Save draft keeps your work without sending it for review. Follow any message shown about reopening or replacing an existing draft.

submit.title: Send for review
submit.body: Check the workbook and any required evidence or declaration first. Submit asks for confirmation before sending; it does not approve or publish your data.

cancel.title: Return to your templates
cancel.body: Cancel leaves this workspace. If you have unsaved changes, you will be asked before they are discarded.

completed.title: Your submission is received
completed.body: Your workbook has been sent for review. SSD still needs to review it; it has not been approved or published.

preview.title: Check what you sent
preview.body: Preview opens the exact workbook you just submitted, in read-only mode.

assignments-back.title: Continue with your assignments
assignments-back.body: Return to the list to see your templates and their latest status.

preview-workbook.title: Your submitted workbook
preview-workbook.body: This is a read-only view of the file you sent. Use the sheet tabs and scroll to inspect the data.

preview-close.title: Back to the confirmation
preview-close.body: Close preview when you have finished checking your submission.
